note: v1, written: THE STAIR COMES DOWN, the tape's closer. Ambient deep house (the style board's t18 row), 120 bpm then a decelerando to 112 over the last 32 bars, D minor (7A) rising a fifth to A minor (8A): home, where t1 began. 5:59. The featured illusion: THE STAIR, which t1 taught as an endlessly rising Shepard scale, falls for ever. Its four notes (5 3 2 1) on Shepard tones (chirper-two's c2-stair recipe, centred at 1.2 kHz), counted downward without restarting: A F E D A ... in D minor, E C B A E ... at home. Every step is smaller than a tritone (-4 -1 -2 -5), so each is heard falling, and the stair descends for six minutes without getting lower, the night's climb undone without losing height. Under the break, falling Shepard chords (a pad gliding down an octave every 8 s). A soft machine-kit groove with a 7-bar hat filter LFO, glassy pads, a pumped sub with phantom harmonics, a 3/16 echo on the stair. Stepped section lanes; the kick leaves at bar 161 and the stair falls on alone at half speed into a held A minor. Seam per the mix plan: in over a held D2 (t17's outro at 120). Master: -11.1 LUFS, true peak -1.29 dBTP, levels 100 (pinned run 1). compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 88.745/88.597/88.735/88.523. The draft read 80.3 (spectrum 29: the top 16-19 dB under the genre); brightened (hats up, the Shepard centre 600 -> 1200 Hz, an air shelf) and the 1.4 kHz Shepard peak notched. Roots an octave up with an outro without hats read 88.25 (structure 95, but recurrence and cohesion fell).

note: v12, written (judgment keep: Harry 14:50, 'the final track should bring in every element and work out simultaneously running like all illusions at once in interplay... a long trippy odyssey to close the album out'; album.json now asks 12-20 min): THE ODYSSEY. 400 bars, 806.9 s. DESCENT 32 (the seam from t17 kept: kick, hats, held D2, soft rims; then the falling stair) / GALLERY: fifteen 16-bar panels, each illusion of the tape in front in turn - t1 Shepard stair up, t2/t16 barber-pole filter, t3 speech-to-song ('the stair comes down', spoken then sung on the stair), t4/t11 tritone pairs, t5 streaming (one acid line splitting as its gap widens 2 -> 12 st), t6 missing fundamental (the bass nobody plays; the real sub as the reveal), t7 octave illusion, t8 continuity (a glass line singing on through static), t9 beat flip (kick out, back half a beat late, doubt, home), t10 Zwicker (notched noise, a bar of digital silence, the bell on the note), t12 Huggins (a note between the ears in hiss, walking the stair), t13 Risset accelerando, t14 scale illusion, t17 the turning room, t15 Risset decelerando - over two darker chord worlds (Dm9 Bbmaj9#11 Gm9 A7b9; a Phrygian D pedal with Ebmaj7) / INTERLOCK 4x16 by register (low, mid, high, time: Risset up AND down at once with the flip and the turning room) / ALL 32: thirteen at once with the falling stair on top, ending in a Zwicker silence / CODA 32: no kick, the falling Shepard chords in A minor, 120 -> 112, ending on the stair's open 2.
